keyLimits.en: 5 pages, up to 500 monthly visitors, 1 user, 1 root domain.
Unlimited pages, up to 20,000 monthly visitors, 1 user, 1 root domain; includes popups, sticky bars, multi-step forms, AI copywriting, 1,000+ integrations.
Unlimited A/B testing, up to 30,000 monthly visitors, 3 users, 2 root domains, unlimited variants, manual traffic allocation, confidence intervals, dynamic text replacement.
AI traffic optimization, up to 50,000 monthly visitors, 5 users, 3 root domains, page/popup scheduling, advanced triggers, industry benchmarking, audience insights.
Unlimited pages, 100,000+ monthly visitors, higher user/domain limits, dedicated success manager, implementation services.

cautions.en: The entry Starter plan caps visitors at 500/month and provides only 5 pages, well below what most active landing-page campaigns need; Build is the first plan without a page cap.

capabilities.en: Drag-and-drop landing page builder with 100+ templates and AI copywriting assistance.
Built-in A/B testing with unlimited variants, manual traffic allocation and statistical confidence intervals on higher plans.
Popups, sticky bars and multi-step forms for on-site conversion, plus 1,000+ third-party integrations.

limitations.en: Monthly visitor caps apply to every plan (from 500 to 50,000); exceeding them requires an upgrade.
A/B testing tools are gated to the Experiment plan and above, not available on Starter or Build.

reason.en: Direct competitor focused on standalone landing pages with a similar drag-and-drop builder.
Landing page and conversion optimization platform targeting the same PPC/marketing use case.
More general visual web builder that can also serve as a landing-page tool with deeper design control.
Lightweight single-page site builder, a much cheaper alternative for simple landing pages.
